background_tasks.description: What the runtime still had running in the background when this happened, as it listed it: a command, a subagent. Each entry is the runtime's own, with an id, a type, a status and a description, and the command of a shell or the type of a subagent. A task in one list and in no list after it has ended; the runtime reports no exit status and no time for it. Absent when the runtime reports no list.

message.description: The subagent's last message, as text.
